issue.title: NewMessage event stop getting update

comments.body:
You need to call a high level request so that telegram knows you want to receive updates. 
SendMessage is one of those. 
Another one is client.getMe(). you can call that after you .connect each time

but, It is safe to do?

```js
setInterval(client.getMe, 5000)
```
no, just call it once after connecting.

as I said in the previous comment it should be after connecting.
client = new TelegramClient(.....
await client.connect()
await client.getMe()
yes, I do that in the first place, but still the event not receiving any update (like the first case)
could you share full code?

are you using an old version of the library maybe? 
does anything suspicious show in the logs?
can you share the logs when that happens?

[out.log](https://github.com/gram-js/gramjs/files/8319436/out.log)

like, nothing strange there

oops, my settings was:

```
  connectionRetries: 5,
  useWSS: true,
```

now I remove that 2 args, the error still exist
Are you running the same session twice ?
no sir, only one, one running program and one running client instance

then I honestly have no idea, 
Maybe you should try running client.getMe() every minute to wake up the script.

I think maybe its something with the Telegram API, because I'm getting the same issue

I can send messages, can do anything I want, but sadly no updates are coming 

No updates even after doing all the recommendations

(I noticed that updates are kinda restricted, I get only channel post messages, not comments on posts from people)
As I said it before, the New Message updates are restricted, they do come from private chats, channel posts, but not from channel discussions (comment section), which is kinda sad

I am not getting NewMessage event triggered of new channels, seems not related to timeout, I am receiving the new message trigger for old channels but not for the new channels. can someone please help here? It seems the session is alive but there is some internal issue.

Hi everyone, I'm currently working on a tool to forward group messages, but the development is stalled due to this issue, is there a better way to resolve this?

I can't listen to any messages after 2 minutes, but everything was fine before that.

I'm not good at python, can anyone here confirm that this problem also occurs with telethon?
I tried everything I could, nothing worked. I switched to the TDL library, there is no such problem there.
I have a similar issue: some updates come in, some don't, it seems to be random... I try to receive channel posts.
Same issue

Same issue, has anyone found a solution? 
Maybe desktop clients are sending some kind of ping?
